name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.303.0 — A review-driver legs re-run (--mark skips-extracted, --mark repair-round) over an unchanged tree copies the prior iteration's green rows for the expensive legs and spawns only the red or input-dependent ones; a changed tree re-runs everything, and a leg that went red then green over the same tree is named flaky in the driver output and sidecar. 7.302.0 — Scripts piped to a reader that closes early (count-tests.js --titles | head) no longer crash with exit 1: the sync writer moves to lib/sync-write.js, which treats EPIPE as done and keeps the script's own exit code. 7.301.0 — core § Doctrine Authoring now names the three kinds of prose pin (references, retired phrases, protocol tokens) and states that a pin on the wording of a rule is not a test; wording is read by review.
